parent.settings_call_contract: Pass DisplacementSettings(**settings) only; omit API time_limit_seconds and minimum_increment arguments. Explicit modes; do not use zero-start defaults.
parent.readiness: success/path_completed/target_reached/loading_peak_reached true; exact original target coverage; last accepted original target .50; original numerical gates all accepted states

probe.settings_inheritance: All new parent nonclock settings and modes; only probe clock is explicit.
probe.fresh_q0: Original parent split lift/fluctuation and signed R; fresh F/T, checks=1 and identity unchanged; no repair/projection.
probe.motion: Original body membership; all body ux=q, uy=0 and rotation=0. Original supports/symmetry retained. No remask.

inherited_grid_expectation.note: Inherited metadata expectations, not a newly built or array-validated low-input model.

signed_scalars: tip to physical raster body boundary
body to actual free right boundary
comparison.exclusions: No high/low force difference is automatically pure contact/friction/capacity; no zero-preload subtraction replacing raw values.

execution_policy: Future implementation/freeze/static review before unique launch. Sequential separately supervised parent, probe and viewer processes. Each API once. First terminal error stops downstream science/display; retain partial. Original internal backtracking/bisection allowed; no external retry, repair rerun, extension, force, HP, tests, default installation or automatic rollback.

PNGs: Actual x1 low probe geometry and tip at q0/terminal
Signed low forces, held input and all low/parent convergence diagnostics
Low right480 and all nonbody-medium J/Hu witnesses
High/low same-q original force/components/increments and geometry-medium scalars
display_plan.GIF: All actual accepted low probe states, actual frame count; no interpolation or old media opening.
display_plan.array_reads: New low probe fields J/Hu only, at most 17 archives/34 fields; positions/model from new ordinary JSON. Original high state_table only; no old high NPZ or image pixels.
display_plan.note: Four plots are a planned display budget, not generated evidence. Parent reference and terminal geometry can use new probe reference coordinates and its identity-matched q0 positions; this does not promise all parent intermediate deformations. Figure details freeze with the thin wrapper.

qualification: Numerical guided displacement response only; no independent HP, pressure, effective grasp, bearing, release, stability, alpha/domain independence or HF5.
prerequisite: This preparation is complete only after independent finite review. Future wrapper sources/observer bindings and precise launch command must be frozen and statically reviewed under a new approved execution card. This file is not an executable launcher.
